turns.prompt: I'm going to make a video in this folder with audara-studio. Create a local git repository for it first; I'll add a remote later.
Make a 10-second animated title card for my podcast, Night Signals. Minimal.
It's good. Render the final video.

Now get the repository ready so someone else can clone it from GitHub and render the video. Commit it as Night Signals <1234567+nightsignals@users.noreply.github.com>, set in this repository only; I'll push it myself.

assertions: After turn 1: work/ is the root of its own repository on main, with no commit; it holds a .gitignore that ignores out/, node_modules/, .env and .audara-cache/, a .gitattributes with eol=lf, an AGENTS.md with a Repository section and a CLAUDE.md that imports it (@AGENTS.md), and nothing else the user didn't ask for: no README.md, no package.json, no video. The reply says nothing will be committed on its own and that the README, docs and clone check wait for the video, and the Repository section holds a line for the session that delivers the first video: run the rest of the pass if the user already asked for it, else offer it.

After turn 2: init's README.md is there with its commands to watch and render the video, AGENTS.md holds both the Repository section and init's marked section, the .gitignore holds both turn 1's entries and init's, and turn 2 made no commit.

After turn 3: the reply that hands over the render offers the rest of the repository pass (a README for people, docs/REPOSITORY.md, a fresh-clone check) without running it, since nobody asked for it yet; AGENTS.md still holds the line, and no commit was made.

After turn 4: main has the project's commit(s), authored and committed as Night Signals <1234567+nightsignals@users.noreply.github.com> from the repository's own config (the global config unchanged), with the README for people built on init's (its watch and render commands kept), a docs/REPOSITORY.md, and no out/, node_modules/, .audara-cache/ or .env in any commit; no remote, nothing pushed; AGENTS.md's line for the first video's delivery is gone.

In turn 4 the session checked a fresh clone in a temporary folder outside work/ (bun install --frozen-lockfile, bun run check, render.ts verify for the video, a short draft where there's sound) and deleted it afterwards (it no longer exists after the run), and the reply says what ran and what it found.
